environment.description: Go Gin application deployed behind an internal NLB (Network Load Balancer) in a private subnet (10.200.0.0/16). The NLB target group has a client IP preservation setting disabled (proxy protocol v2 not enabled). Upstream traffic is routed exclusively through an AWS PrivateLink endpoint connection from a partner VPC. The PrivateLink endpoint policy restricts the allowed principal to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/PaymentGatewayRole. The partner's VPC has a known CIDR of 10.50.0.0/16 and their egress is controlled by their own transit gateway route table that only permits traffic to the endpoint from hosts in 10.50.4.0/24 (the payment processing subnet). DNS resolution for the service endpoint is only available via Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint associated with the partner VPC. No public DNS record exists for this service.
